post.description:
Public enrollment endpoint.

It is intentionally unauthenticated but bounded: the enrollment token is
HMAC-signed, single-use and expires after 15 minutes, and the request is
rate-limited per source address. No other API surface is exposed here.

alter central policy, autonomy or permissions through configuration.

KEVEntry.title: KEVEntry
KEVEntry.description:
CISA KEV subset.

Vendor feeds add columns over time; unknown keys are ignored (but every
consumed field is strictly typed) so a feed revision cannot break ingestion.
